title: Mechanical Design Engineer
reason: Stack +7; Title fit +6; Exp fit +10; US +10
description_preview:
As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will be a member of the Engineering Team that designs and develops laboratory and medical devices based on product and market requirements. You will take part in designing, testing, and verifying instruments, systems, subsystems, and individual components, in compliance with ISO 13485, IVDR, MDR, and FDA design and development procedures. Your work will directly advance our mission to make people safer, healthier, and more productive.
Under the general direction of the Director of Engineering, you will:
Work with others in a group setting and lead mechanical design activities for new product development, product enhancements, and engineering change projects from concept through commercialization.
Design innovative laboratory and medical devices that integrate mechanical, electrical, and optical systems while balancing performance, manufacturability, quality, cost, and customer needs.
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations to develop practical, customer-focused solutions.
Create and maintain accurate 3D models, engineering drawings, assemblies, tooling designs, and related technical documentation using SolidWorks or equivalent CAD software.
Utilize engineering analysis tools, including Finite Element Analysis (FEA), to evaluate product performance, reliability, and durability.
Design with manufacturing in mind by applying Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Serviceability principles.
Develop, build, and evaluate prototypes while partnering with internal teams, suppliers, and external development partners.
Plan and execute engineering testing, verification, and validation activities to ensure designs meet product requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
Create and maintain multi-level Bills of Material (BOMs), engineering specifications, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
Support manufacturing through production launches, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, continuous improvement initiatives, and implementation of design improvements.
Participate in risk management activities and design reviews to ensure product safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.
Contribute to a culture of innovation by identifying opportunities to improve products, processes, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Support cross-functional problem-solving while promoting teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
Requirements
A passion for working in a fast-paced, safety-oriented, mission-driven manufacturing environment.
Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality work within project timelines.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn new technologies, processes, and industry standards.
Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, material selection, manufacturing processes, and product development methodologies.
A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and lead change effectively.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Desired Education And Experience
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, plus at least 1 year of directly related experience.
Experience designing components using sheet metal, machined parts, injection molded plastics, and other common manufacturing processes.
Working knowledge of engineering standards and regulatory requirements applicable to medical devices (UL, CE, ANSI, ISO, and FDA preferred).
Experience with embedded electronics or electro-mechanical systems is beneficial.
Alternate education and experience are considered based on the individual candidate.
Computer Skills
SolidWorks or similar CAD software
MS Office Suite products to create specification sheets, work instructions, manuals, and spreadsheets.
MS Project or similar project management tools preferred.
Physical And Work Environment Requirements
Demonstrate a consistent commitment to maintaining a safe work environment for yourself and others.
Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and required personal protective equipment (PPE) practices.
Occasionally lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
Office and manufacturing environments.
Travel Requirements
Frequent local travel during the business day, mostly between work locations.
Occasional overnight travel may occur.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a mission-driven company helping make people safer, healthier, and more productive.
Know that your leadership directly impacts the safety and reliability of products used in laboratories, by healthcare providers, and by patients worldwide.
Join a team that takes pride in craftsmanship, quality, and doing work that truly matters.
Lead and develop high-performing teams within a collaborative environment that values continuous improvement and operational excellence.
At Drucker Diagnostics, we know that behind every great product is a great person. We would be honored to have you join our team and our vision for
building something truly remarkable that will long outlast us!
Benefits
401k with company match
Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits
Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with company match
Employer-paid Basic Life Insurance with AD&D coverage
Up to 10 paid holidays per year plus your birthday
Personal Time Off (PTO)
